title.zh: 查询VPC边界防火墙的详情

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于获取VPC边界防火墙的详细信息。该VPC边界防火墙是防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量。
调用本接口前，必须已经调用[CreateVpcFirewallConfigure](~~342893~~)接口创建了VPC边界防火墙。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries the details of a VPC firewall. The VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs that are connected by an Express Connect circuit. Before you call this operation, you must create a VPC firewall by calling the [CreateVpcFirewallConfigure](~~342893~~) operation.

## QPS limit

This operation has a queries per second (QPS) limit of 10 calls per second for each user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls are throttled. This can affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-detail --lang zh --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --local-vpc-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --peer-vpc-id vpc-90rq0anm6t8vbwbo0000 --region cn-hangzhou
